{
  "dataset_name": "postcutoff_ro_real_estate_20260503",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "area_zero_or_placeholder_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "1 when area_sqm is zero or less, marking a likely placeholder or unusable size entry; 0 otherwise.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "data_quality_size",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Lets trees separate zero-size records before applying size and density splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(area_sqm <= 0.0, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "area_size_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket from training-fold area_sqm scale: 0 at or below 42.1211, 1 up to 69.7701, 2 up to 97.4192, 3 above.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "size_bucket",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides direct coarse size cuts that a tree can use without searching only on raw continuous values.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(area_sqm <= 42.1211, 0, np.where(area_sqm <= 69.7701, 1, np.where(area_sqm <= 97.4192, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "room_count_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal room bucket: 0 for one-room, 1 for two-room, 2 for three-room, 3 for four or more based on half-step thresholds.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "room_count",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes common dwelling layout groups with stable split points.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(rooms <= 1.5, 0, np.where(rooms <= 2.5, 1, np.where(rooms <= 3.5, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "area_per_room_sqm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Living area per room with rooms clipped below at 1 to avoid division issues.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        180.9
      ],
      "feature_family": "room_area_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures spaciousness interaction between room count and size.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "area_sqm / np.maximum(rooms, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "space_per_room_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal spaciousness per room: 0 at or below 20 sqm, 1 up to 35 sqm, 2 up to 50 sqm, 3 above 50 sqm.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "room_area_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives trees a ready compact-to-spacious interaction feature with intuitive cut points.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((area_sqm / np.maximum(rooms, 1.0)) <= 20.0, 0, np.where((area_sqm / np.maximum(rooms, 1.0)) <= 35.0, 1, np.where((area_sqm / np.maximum(rooms, 1.0)) <= 50.0, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "room_area_mismatch_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "1 when room count and area form an atypical layout: at least 3 rooms with at most 55 sqm or one room with at least 75 sqm.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "layout_anomaly",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Isolates unusual layouts that may behave differently from ordinary room-area combinations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(((rooms >= 3.0) & (area_sqm <= 55.0)) | ((rooms <= 1.0) & (area_sqm >= 75.0)), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "floor_position_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Buckets floor value into below-grade or special, low-rise, mid-rise, upper, high, and very high bands using domain and training-fold cut points.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        5
      ],
      "feature_family": "vertical_position",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures step changes from access, views, or floor-code effects that tree splits can reuse.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(floor < 0.0, 0, np.where(floor <= 4.0, 1, np.where(floor <= 10.0, 2, np.where(floor <= 22.0954, 3, np.where(floor <= 38.9928, 4, 5)))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "scrape_time_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket for scraped_at using training-fold chronology scale: 0 early or lower, 1 lower-mid, 2 upper-mid, 3 late or upper.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "time_batch",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures batch or time-period shifts as a split-friendly ordinal feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(scraped_at <= 634.8297, 0, np.where(scraped_at <= 1460.5724, 1, np.where(scraped_at <= 2286.3151, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "location_code_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Buckets location numeric value using training-fold mean and one-standard-deviation cut points.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "location_code",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups geography codes into broad bands so trees can learn coarse location effects with fewer cuts.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(location <= 11.9511, 0, np.where(location <= 21.6537, 1, np.where(location <= 31.3564, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_code_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Buckets title numeric value using training-fold mean and one-standard-deviation cut points; treats the field as an encoded title or title-length signal.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "title_code",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Condenses high-cardinality or length-like title signal into a small ordinal set for direct tree splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(title <= 29.8459, 0, np.where(title <= 70.4558, 1, np.where(title <= 111.0657, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "location_semantic_appeal_tier",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal semantic score from the row's location value plus training-fold location codebook or name: 0 unknown or remote wording, 1 peripheral wording, 2 ordinary urban wording, 3 well-connected or amenity-rich wording, 4 central or landmark-proximate wording. Assign without sale or asking amounts.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        4
      ],
      "feature_family": "location_semantics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Supplies compact, human-readable geography context that tree splits can combine with room and area features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "title_semantic_quality_tier",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal semantic score from the row's title value plus training-fold title codebook or text: 0 missing or vague wording, 1 generic property wording, 2 clear property type or condition, 3 renovation, new-building, furnishing, or amenity wording, 4 multiple strong quality or amenity cues. Assign without sale or asking amounts.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        4
      ],
      "feature_family": "title_semantics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Converts title wording into a small ordinal feature so trees can split on presentation and amenity cues.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
